role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 兼具极高的机动性和攻击性，裂魂人可以跨越整个地图发动冲刺，使敌人陷入战斗。手中沉重的灯笼痛击着敌人，每次敲出的重击让他们意识模糊。他的敌人可以逃，但是他们无处可藏。
hero_summary_en: Highly mobile and always aggressive, Spirit Breaker charges across the map to bring the fight to his enemies. With each bash of his heavy lantern, he knocks his foes senseless. His enemies may run, but with the help of a few wards, they cannot hide.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.

shard_loc.en: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成提升%bonus_movement_speed%。

facet_text_en: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
facet_text_zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成会在冲刺结束后逐渐消失。

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人获得移动速度和状态抗性加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
abilities.description_zh: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.

scepter_loc.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
scepter_loc.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。

facet_text_en: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 过去%bonus_chance_duration%秒内对不止一名英雄触发了巨力重击就会使重击的概率提升。第一个英雄之后每个英雄都会使巨力重击的概率提升%bonus_chance_pct%%%。

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
abilities.description_zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
abilities.description_en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes_zh: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过%break_distance%，位面空洞效果会停止。
notes_en: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人只要眩晕敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个眩晕的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes_zh: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。
notes_en: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
notes_zh: 裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
facet_text_en: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
facet_text_zh: 被幽冥一击击中的敌方目标受到友方的击退效果的移动距离更远。
